subject: psychology
title: Forgetting Adventure
welcome_lead: Why do we forget? Brains have reasons. 🤯
meta_desc: Memory & Learning Adventure 2 — KS3 Psychology on why we forget and how to remember better.
final_note: You learned why we forget and tricks to remember more.

concepts.def: A memory trick like a rhyme

walkthroughs.body_html:
Two main reasons:

  • Decay — memory fades when not used.
  • Interference — new info crowds out old.

Sometimes the memory is still there — we just can't find it. 🔍

A cue is a hint that pulls the memory out.

Walking back to where you left your keys often helps — the place itself is a cue.

Tricks to remember more:

  • Mnemonics — 'Richard Of York Gave Battle In Vain' for rainbow colours.
  • Spacing — small reviews across days.
  • Sleep — your brain files memories overnight.
  • Teaching it to someone else.
